diagnosis: The Nx distributed task execution cache endpoint serves build output archives by taskId without checking that the requesting developer's workspace matches taskArtifact.workspaceId. Any authenticated developer in a shared monorepo cluster can download compiled microservices and test outputs generated by other proprietary workspaces.
